verses.1:
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil + 54:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142. of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?”
 Save me, O God, by Your name,
 and vindicate me by Your might!
verses.2:
Hear my prayer, O God;
 listen to the words of my mouth.
verses.3:
For strangers rise up against me,
 and ruthless men seek my life —
 men with no regard for God.
 Selah
verses.4:
Surely God is my helper;
 the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
verses.5:
He will reward my enemies with evil.
 In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
verses.6:
Freely I will sacrifice to You;
 I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
verses.7:
For He has delivered me from every trouble,
 and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
